metadata.validation: Internal holdout, NOT unseen external data; Phase 1 explored the dataset.

protocol.selection: Each mode/policy/cohort independently selects on training-only CV; classification max mean F1 at .5, regression min mean RMSE. No policy winner is chosen on holdout.
protocol.calibration: Brier score assesses probability error; no claim that probabilities are calibrated.
protocol.target_cohorts: Raw regression targets are finite pH; physical-valid targets additionally lie in [0,14]. Cohorts have independent task-specific splits and may differ in size; within each cohort every mode and feature policy shares identical rows.
protocol.uncertainty: CV standard deviation is across folds, not a confidence interval. FPR Wilson intervals are descriptive, not safety guarantees.
protocol.stress: Configuration fixed from primary CV; each stress threshold refit on that stress training partition OOF only. Stress is not independent external validation.
protocol.limits: No external validation or model promotion. Source order may not represent time/source. Deduplication across quick and sanitized views conservatively removes rows and changes population. OOF selection/threshold estimates are optimistic without nested CV. Physical-valid target filtering cannot establish measurement truth.
protocol.cpu: threadpool limit 2; RF n_jobs=2; permutation n_jobs=1; sequential experiments

duplicates.definition: Exact equality of all numeric feature values; missing equals missing. No rows removed.

importance.scope: Primary internal holdout, original input feature columns; descriptive, not used for selection.
